articles.title: Pokémon Cards Are Tiny Art Galleries Now — And This New Set Proves It
articles.summary: Imagine opening a pack and finding a meerkat Pokémon on a rooftop, watching a city. The new Chaos Rising set is packed with gorgeous art that tells tiny stories. It’s less about battling and more about collecting beautiful mini-posters.

articles.title: This Video Game Lets You Run a Cozy Japanese Convenience Store at Night
articles.summary: In Inkonbini, you play as Makoto, who works the night shift at a small Japanese store. You stock shelves, chat with customers, and help them solve problems. It’s like a warm hug in game form — perfect for a lazy afternoon.

articles.title: A Maid’s Video Diary Turns Into a Surprising, Heartfelt Movie
articles.summary: The Diary of a Chambermaid is about Gianina, a Romanian maid in Paris who misses her daughter. She acts in a silly play, but the real story is her video calls home. It’s funny and weird, then suddenly very touching.
